parsed.explanation: The dossier documents state-directed targeting of gender-nonconforming people: police arrest on clothing and appearance (a gender-expression lever, not merely a sexuality statute), Article 274 used as a standing extortion mechanism with release bought from officers, and trans women imprisoned on a protective pretext into male prisons where sexual violence is recurrent — a tier-1/tier-2 exposure with no working remedy. A 2023 investigative unit for same-sex conduct shows active, recent enforcement; custody abuse is corroborated across multiple reports (2011, 2023, 2024). Recourse is absent: no protections, hostile officials, 87% societal hostility, stigmatisation hindering reporting. No death penalty or documented killings, and no visitor-specific border practice is sourced, so it sits above the severe band — but police appearance-based stops reach an outed visitor directly. Comparable to the 0.25-A anchor, weighted slightly lower for missing incident recency and no torture rate.
